title: pectis leptocephala
intro: Pectis leptocephala, commonly known as Mexican daisy, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fever, as well as supporting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids. Pectis leptocephala is a rich source of bioactive compounds, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
